description: Agent Post-Training Data project-local triage rules. Keep data-mechanism papers here; move RL-algorithm papers to /Users/chy/Research/agentic-rl/.
hard_gates: Queue row is not a card.
Survey mention is recall evidence, not paper evidence.
No original paper PDF/HTML brief, no formal L1 card.
Formal L1 cards in notes/ root must pass scripts/autoresearch.py validate before being reported as complete.
select_rules: Core contribution is agent post-training data generation, filtering, verification, repair, reweighting, curriculum, failure trajectory mining, or search-to-SFT distillation.
Directly changes tool-call, trajectory, observation-action, replay, synthetic task, executable environment, real-world log, or verifier-based data pipeline.
Could create novelty risk for an Agent Post-Training Data idea.
maybe_rules: Useful background for data-centric alignment, tool-use taxonomy, benchmark/eval protocol, or SFT/RL interface.
Mixed data/RL paper where data contribution is plausible but not yet verified.
move_to_agentic_rl_rules: Core contribution is reward design, policy optimization, RL update mechanics, online exploration, or long-horizon credit assignment.
SFT/data is only a standard warm start or implementation detail.
